# Mika Reyes — AI Guides (full list)

> Every published AI guide on https://mikareyes.com/ai, newest first, each with its description. Practical, copy-paste how-to guides — mostly Claude, plus prompts that work in any LLM — aligned with what Mika shares on Instagram and TikTok.

For the site overview and other sections, see [llms.txt](https://mikareyes.com/llms.txt). Browse and filter by tag at [/ai](https://mikareyes.com/ai).
